title: Nevada test fallout theory dismissed as baseless

tellings.quote: Yeah, some of the testing in Nevada could have

plain: One idea is that fallout from nuclear testing in Nevada might explain the strange things reported on Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah ranch known for reports of odd events. Its owner, Brandon Fugal, takes it up with Michels, saying "some of the testing in Nevada could have," though the conversation is recorded as him setting the theory aside as baseless. If it held, it would put an ordinary cause behind at least some of the ranch's mysteries.
